'''Chief Healer''' was the title used in both the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Old]] and [[New Jedi Order]]s to denote the [[Jedi healer/Legends|healer]] who oversaw the [[Halls of Healing]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. This individual, a member of the [[Circle of Jedi Healers/Legends|Circle of Jedi Healers]], was a highly respected member of the Temple staff and had vast knowledge of the [[Force healing/Legends|healing arts]].
